purpose: Fail-closed contract for molecule-, conformer-, text-pair-, split-, and task-level overlap evidence. Source record IDs from different datasets are never treated as chemical identities. This contract does not admit P1 or P2 training.

identity_semantics.source_member_id: A membership identity inside one declared source namespace. It proves set closure, but is not comparable across CID, PCQM row index, QM9 ID, ChEBI ID, or another namespace.
identity_semantics.connectivity_identity: SHA-256 of a molecule identity generated by one frozen, shared connectivity-normalization specification. This is the primary leakage key and intentionally collapses stereoisomers.
identity_semantics.stereo_identity: SHA-256 of a molecule identity generated by one frozen, shared stereochemistry-preserving normalization specification.
identity_semantics.conformer_identity: Optional SHA-256 generated by one frozen, shared conformer comparison specification. A coordinate byte hash or source atom-order hash is not cross-dataset comparable unless the specification proves canonical atom order and geometric normalization.
identity_semantics.text_exact: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 bytes of one frozen text unit. The extraction specification must declare whether that unit is an encoder input, decoder target, or canonical routed input-target object; these units cannot be mixed silently.
identity_semantics.text_normalized: SHA-256 of the same frozen text unit after one shared normalization specification. It is reported separately from molecular overlap.
identity_semantics.connectivity_text_pair: SHA-256 of canonical JSON over the connectivity identity and normalized text identity, independent of source row ID and task label.
identity_semantics.stereo_text_pair: SHA-256 of canonical JSON over the stereo identity and normalized text identity, independent of source row ID and task label.

canonical_jsonl.serialization: JSON object with ensure_ascii=false, keys sorted, separators comma and colon, followed by exactly one LF
canonical_jsonl.row_order: strict ascending UTF-8 bytes of member_id for molecule rows and pair_id for text-pair rows
canonical_jsonl.key_set_digest: SHA-256 of each ordered key encoded as UTF-8 followed by LF

required_fail_closed_rules: Every referenced manifest and row file is a regular non-symlink file whose byte count and SHA-256 match its declaration.
Every member_id is unique within a collection, and every text pair references one molecule member in the same collection.
Every collection has at least one molecule row; available text-pair artifacts have at least one row, so an empty set cannot produce a vacuous pass.
Collection role, phase, split, and task-family declarations are mutually consistent.
Connectivity and stereo comparisons are permitted only when both collections bind the exact same identity-specification SHA-256.
A distinct source ID, stereo key, or conformer key never cancels a connectivity overlap.
Multiple conformers of the same molecule remain one molecule-level overlap group.
Unavailable conformer or text identity cannot satisfy a required-zero policy.
Every intended downstream task family and split is explicitly enumerated; a proof over only the PubChem holdout cannot be labeled all-downstream exclusion.
P1 and P2 train collections are each compared with every declared downstream validation/test collection at connectivity level.
Within-task downstream train/validation/test isolation is proven independently when requested.
Exact and normalized molecule-text pair overlap is independently measured whenever both compared collections expose text-pair rows.
LMDB metadata keys such as __len__ are excluded by the extractor and enumerated in the collection manifest; database entry count is not accepted as molecule count.

policy_requirements.p1_to_p2: The request must explicitly select disjoint_required, explicitly_declared, or replay_permitted. The gate does not choose this scientific policy.

not_an_admission: A passing overlap report proves only the collections, task families, splits, identity specifications, and dimensions bound by that report. It never implies P1 or P2 training admission.
